Compose the Question Label for a Ratio

Source: R/analysis_pipeline.R
ck_ratio_label.Rd

A ratio's analysis_var is the composite key built by ck_loa_var_key, which is never a column of the export, so the ordinary label lookup misses it and the output would show raw question codes where every other row shows label text.

Usage

ck_ratio_label(
  analysis_var,
  label_lookup,
  sm_separator = "/",
  joiner = " per "
)

Arguments

analysis_var

One analysis_var value.

label_lookup

A named vector from ck_build_label_lookup.

sm_separator

Separator between parent and choice. Default "/".

joiner

Text placed between the two labels. Default " per ".

Value

A single label, or NA_character_ when either half is unlabelled or the value is not a ratio key.

Details

Both halves must resolve, or the raw key is kept: "How many children are travelling with you? per Q11" reads worse than "Q12 \ least says plainly that nothing was labelled.
